source_note: All implementation, tests and canonical recipes retain the full-gate hashes. Final contract/handoff closure edits are documentation only; each build report preserves its original tested fingerprint.
status: bounded original collected-Mead slice accepted; full M16 and expedition remain open

content.effects: DRAT1 Intelligence and Willpower, 60 seconds Self; instant REFA2

behavior: Each ordinary inventory use consumes exactly one selected bottle, applies all three effects atomically, updates native attribute/resource authority and persists a separate source/elapsed lifetime. Same-source drains stack and expire separately; reload neither consumes nor replays instant restoration. Legacy modifiers are not inferred as ownership.

python_reuse.scope: Reuse original full Python execution with its original fingerprint. Later changes were canonical JSON recipes, docs and a C++ fixture correction; Python sources remain unchanged.

normal_runtime_binary_link.scope: The runtime executable used by all nine real normal courses is byte-identical to the game built by the passing full normal C++ integration gate.

instrumented_runtime_binary_link.scope: Five actual instrumented game processes use the executable built by the passing full engine gate; directly linked sanitizer libraries observed in process maps. Rendered leak detection disabled, UBSan halts.

retained_failures.normal-focused-engine-01: New deleted-record test called its throwing fixture helper after deletion. Corrected by checking nullable store lookup and rejecting a retained copy of the deleted source; focused retry02 and broad suites pass.
retained_failures.baseline_and_original_bootstrap: Retained in contract/oracle with original provenance; baseline unsupported consumption and test setup errors are not passing feature evidence.

limitations: Tested actual Player has zero native Magic Resistance; general resistance, absorption, arbitrary potions/effects and NPC drinking remain open.
Rendered sanitizer courses disable leak detection; full engine sanitizer tests enable it.
Original control used isolated original copies and original form grants only within that independent control; the fork course uses actually collected bottles and ordinary exertion.

visual_reviews.observation: Both reviewed images show the actual original Mead (2), localized Weight1/Value2, DRAT1 Intelligence and Willpower for60s Self, and REFA2 Self.

outgoing_checkpoint.behavior: Separate same-source clocks persist across processes, each expires once at60, all attribute/resource bases return, and completed reload neither reapplies nor consumes.
